description: Filters the volumes a NeuroVue window lists in its dataset pane, by text and by image type or role, and shows the pane. Each call replaces the filter; a call with no filters lists every volume again.

query.description: Text a volume's name or metadata must contain, such as a subject ("sub-01") or a task.

image_types.description: Image types to keep, as the dataset tool reports them, such as "T1w", "T2w" or "BOLD".

listed.description: The volumes the filter keeps, out of how many, with the image types and roles the dataset has and how many of each.

useWhen: Narrow a large dataset to the volumes of one type, subject or task, so the person sees just those.
Learn which image types and roles a dataset has.
effects: Switches the window out of Express to the dataset view, so its dataset pane shows; set_window_mode with express switches it back. The viewer is not reloaded.

failures.meaning: An image type or role is not one the dataset has.
failures.remedy: Use one of the values the error lists.
